name: Recalbox
notes: A folder holds games when a file's lowercased extension is in the system's list (os projects/frontend/es-app/src/systems/SystemManager.cpp:1790-1805).

Each board builds a system.ini against its defconfig, keeping a core whose package it enables and dropping a system left with none (os package/recalbox-romfs2/scripts/systemholder.py:324-342,404; os package/recalbox-romfs2/scripts/systembuilder.py:50).
A files: list holds whole file names instead of extensions (os projects/frontend/es-app/src/games/FolderData.cpp:65-91).
The default core is the lowest priority, the last listed on a tie, and priority.<board> applies on that board (os projects/frontend/es-app/src/emulators/EmulatorManager.cpp:94-111).
